event_videos.source_text:
The two-day flagship leadership workshop on 'Mindfulness'
was held at the Sheraton Grand Hotel on Shaik Zaid Road in Dubai from 28th February 2023 to 1st March 2023. The workshop was organized by Bluzee and delivered by the Director of IIM Kozhikode, Professor Debashis Chatterjee. The workshop was focused on the three core dimensions of insights which are clarity of purpose, commitment to excellence, and compassionate engagement, and how they relate to mindfulness in leadership.
The workshop was designed to provide participants with practical tools to develop their leadership skills using mindfulness practices. The sessions were interactive, and participants engaged in group activities, case studies, and practical exercises to enhance their understanding of the concepts presented.
Professor Debashis Chatterjee's expertise in the field, combined with the event's organization by Bluzee, made this flagship workshop a success. The participants expressed their satisfaction with the quality of the content and delivery, and the workshop received positive feedback for its valuable insights into mindfulness in leadership.

additional_event_news.summary: Bluzee announced an MoU with Rajagiri School of Engineering & Technology for industry–academia collaboration, mentoring and real-world exposure.
additional_event_news.source_text:
Bluzee Signs MOU with RSET
mukundkg
Jul 18, 2025
1 min read
Bluzee is proud to announce the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with
Rajagiri School of Engineering & Technology (RSET)
, cementing a strategic partnership aimed at fostering innovation, industry-academia collaboration, and real-world exposure for budding engineering talent.
The MOU was officially signed by
Mr. Mukundakumar KG
, Co-Founder and Partner at Bluzee, during a formal ceremony held at the RSET campus. This partnership marks a significant step forward in Bluzee’s mission to bridge the gap between academic learning and practical business strategy.
Through this collaboration, Bluzee will work closely with RSET to:
Offer strategic consulting insights for institutional development
Enable student immersion into real-time industry challenges
Guide innovation-driven student projects with mentorship and direction
Host joint events, workshops, and training sessions focused on entrepreneurship and business transformation
Speaking on the occasion, Mr. Mukundakumar shared:
“At Bluzee, we believe in empowering the next generation of thinkers and doers. This partnership with RSET aligns with our vision of shaping industry-ready minds and building sustainable strategy ecosystems within educational institutions.”
This MOU reaffirms Bluzee’s commitment to nurturing future talent and co-creating meaningful change in the Indian education landscape.
Stay tuned for more updates as we kick-start this exciting journey with RSET!

additional_event_news.source_text:
Bluzee ERP Experience Hub Goes Live | Operational from 26th May 2025
mukundkg
May 13, 2025
1 min read
We’re thrilled to announce that the Bluzee ERP Experience Hub is officially becoming operational on 26th May 2025 at our newly set-up office, located next to Companipadi Metro Station, Ernakulam–Aluva Road, Cochin, Kerala.
This one-of-a-kind hub is designed not just to train, but to transform. At Bluzee, we believe:
💡 “A training doesn't guarantee a job — but experience does.”
🎯 Don’t settle for just a job. Build a career that matters.
Through immersive, hands-on exposure in real Odoo ERP projects, Bluzee ERP Experience Hub empowers fresh graduates to become industry-ready professionals, opening doors to global opportunities.
Whether you’re a BCom, BCA, MCA, BTech, or diploma holder — this is your chance to gain the experience that employers value.
👉 Grab your experience. Shape your future.
Welcome to the Bluzee ERP Experience Hub — where careers are built.

Bluzee India – Mega Recruitment Drive for Freshers | 17th May 2025
mukundkg
May 13, 2025
1 min read
On
17th May 2025
,
Bluzee India
hosted a successful
Mega Recruitment Drive
at the
Bluzee ERP Experience Hub
in Cochin, Kerala.The event was specially organized for fresh graduates and diploma holders looking to kickstart their careers in the
IT, ERP, and Business Operations
domains.
🚀 About the Drive
With an enthusiastic turnout from across the state, the drive provided a platform for young talent to showcase their skills and passion.This initiative is part of Bluzee’s vision to
empower the next generation of ERP professionals
and create opportunities where freshers can thrive.
🗓️ Event Details
Date:
17th May 2025
Time:
9:00 AM – 3:00 PM
Venue:
Bluzee ERP Experience Hub, Cochin, Kerala
🎓 Eligibility Criteria
Freshers from the following streams were invited:
BCom, MCom
BCA, MCA
BSc (Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry)
BTech, BE
Diploma holders (Technical & Business domains)
💼 Career Opportunities Offered
Candidates explored opportunities in:
Odoo ERP Implementation & Support
Business Operations & Process Design
IT Services & Technical Support
The recruitment process included a written test followed by interviews conducted by Bluzee’s technical and HR teams.
🌱 Why Bluzee?
At
Bluzee
, we don’t just build software—we build careers.Our work culture focuses on:
Real-time project experience
Industry mentorship
Innovation-driven growth
Learning-first mindset
📣 Looking Ahead
We were thrilled to witness the enthusiasm and energy from so many aspiring professionals.This recruitment drive reaffirmed our belief in creating
meaningful career pathways for youth
.
To stay updated on future hiring events and initiatives, follow us at
www.bluzee.xyz
or reach out to
hr@bluzee.xyz
.
Let’s build the future, one fresher at a time.
